review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: S2 Lurker lair mouth (marker): an open horseshoe reef mouth of silt-crusted shell grit round a darker silt hollow, placed at both posts of every Lurker site so both read as lairs. Authored at R = 1 (the Lurker's drawn radius); the opening faces +X, the post heading. No collision.

textures.name: T_MarkerLairMouth_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_MarkerLairMouth_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

pivot: centre of the ring at lip-top height; all geometry at or below it (Godot y <= 0)
provenance: Original geometry from tools/blender/make_s1_kit.py, surfaced in Blender by tools/blender/make_s1_production.py: procedural shaders baked to textures. No outside sources.
